rationale: Two confirmed implementation gaps require fixes before merge: (1) cleanFormValues is never applied on the save path — pool_config objects with enabled:false and residual numeric values from a prior toggle can be submitted to onConfigChange, violating the spec's pruning contract; (2) the max_size >= min_size cross-field constraint is not re-triggered when min_size changes, leaving a visually stale error state until max_size is touched or Save is clicked. A third finding is a missing unit test for AC criterion 8 (auto-expand on validation issue).

business_review.criterion: Accordion absent when flag is off or not yet loaded
business_review.notes: isSubWorkflowEnabled && isSubWorkflowLoaded double-guard; tested for [false,true] and [true,false].

business_review.criterion: Accordion present when flag is on
business_review.notes: Renders correctly when both booleans are true; tested.

business_review.criterion: Enable Pool toggle shows/hides min_size, max_size, refill_interval_seconds
business_review.notes: watchPoolEnabled conditional wraps all three fields; tested for hidden-by-default and show-after-toggle.

business_review.criterion: max_nesting_level always visible when flag is on
business_review.notes: Placed outside the watchPoolEnabled guard but inside the accordion; tested.

business_review.criterion: max_size < min_size shows inline error and blocks save
business_review.notes: yup .when cross-field constraint fires at save-time trigger(); tested. CR-002 flags a visual-lag UX gap when min_size changes without touching max_size first.

business_review.criterion: Values round-trip via onConfigChange and repopulate on re-open
business_review.notes: getDefaultValues round-trip logic is correct. However saveData never calls cleanFormValues, so an empty/disabled pool_config object (enabled:false, sizes null) may reach onConfigChange when the spec requires it to be pruned (CR-001).

business_review.criterion: Form not dirty on initial render when no pool config set
business_review.notes: getDefaultValues hasAnyValue guard prevents pool_config from entering defaultValues; cleanFormValues used in isDirty normalization; tested.

business_review.criterion: Validation issue on pool_config.* or max_nesting_level auto-expands accordion
business_review.notes: activeIssueAccordion memo and auto-expand useEffect implement this correctly. No unit test coverage (CR-003).

standards_review.notes: All commits in range use EPMCDME-11609: prefix per git-workflow.md.
Sonarjs no-duplicate-string rule satisfied via MSG_POSITIVE / MSG_INTEGER module-level constants. No other blocking quality violations.
No user-controlled server-side execution, no raw SQL, no secrets in diff. All inputs validated via yup schema with numeric range bounds.

findings.location: AdvancedConfigTab.tsx: saveData — calls onConfigChange(schema.cast(getValues())) without cleanFormValues
findings.problem: cleanFormValues is only invoked inside isDirty() for comparison purposes. The actual save path never runs it.
findings.impact: When the user enables pool, fills in min_size/max_size, then toggles pool back off, the form retains {enabled:false, min_size:5, max_size:10, ...} in form state. The all-null/empty/false guard in cleanFormValues would prune this, but since saveData skips cleanFormValues, the partially-filled disabled pool_config is submitted to onConfigChange. The spec requirement that pool_config is absent when unconfigured is not enforced at the save boundary.
findings.recommendation: In saveData, apply cleanFormValues before calling onConfigChange: const cleaned = cleanFormValues(schema.cast(getValues())); reset(cleaned); onConfigChange(cleaned);

findings.location: AdvancedConfigTab.tsx: pool_config.max_size .when('min_size', ...) — sibling constraint not re-triggered on min_size change
findings.problem: react-hook-form's onChange mode validates each field in isolation. When min_size changes, max_size's yup .when('min_size', ...) dependency is not re-evaluated until max_size itself changes or trigger() is called globally.
findings.impact: User sets max_size=5, then raises min_size to 10. The max_size field shows no error until they touch it again or click Save. A user who doesn't revisit max_size after raising min_size sees a visually valid form but gets a save-time error on click.
findings.recommendation: Watch pool_config.min_size and call trigger('pool_config.max_size') when it changes: const watchMinSize = watch('pool_config.min_size'); useEffect(() => { if (watchPoolEnabled) trigger('pool_config.max_size') }, [watchMinSize]).

findings.location: AdvancedConfigTab.test.tsx: AC criterion 8 — auto-expand on validation issue has no unit test
findings.problem: The activeIssueAccordion memo and auto-expand useEffect implement criterion 8 correctly, but no test exercises this path.
findings.impact: If the 'max_nesting_level' or 'pool_config.*' mapping is accidentally removed from activeIssueAccordion, no test will fail.
findings.recommendation: Add a test that renders with mockWorkflowContextValue.activeIssue = { path: 'pool_config.min_size' } and asserts that accordion-Sub-workflow Pool is present in the DOM (i.e., poolConfigExpanded was set to true by the auto-expand effect).
